svg.title: ICA by gradient ascent on two mixed Laplace sources
svg.desc: Left: 700 of 1,500 microphone readings, a sheared cloud with its long arms along two oblique directions. Centre: the same points multiplied by the unmixing matrix found by gradient ascent; the arms now lie along the axes, so each coordinate is one source. Right: the average log-likelihood rising over 400 iterations of batch gradient ascent from the identity matrix and levelling off.
